title: Ordering at a restaurant
objectives: State a nut allergy and ask about ingredients

courseTemplate.setting: The special is grilled salmon. The customer has a nut allergy. Staff can check with the kitchen and offer a side salad.
courseTemplate.openingLine: Are you ready to order, or is there anything you would like to ask about the menu?

targetPatterns.pattern: I'm allergic to nuts. Could you check whether it contains any?

stages.title: Ask about the daily special
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Are you ready to order, or is there anything you would like to ask about the menu?”
successCriteria: The learner can ask about the daily special in their own words.
hints: You can start with “What is today's special? …”

stages.title: State a nut allergy and ask about ingredients
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “Today's special is grilled salmon. Is there anything the kitchen should know?”
successCriteria: The learner can state a nut allergy and ask about ingredients in their own words.
hints: You can start with “I'm allergic to nuts. …”

stages.title: Request a side substitution
stages.instruction: Use the course facts to invite this task. A natural prompt is “I'll check with the kitchen before you order. What side would you prefer?”
successCriteria: The learner can request a side substitution in their own words.
hints: You can start with “Could I have a …”

languageNotes: 不要说 "Give me the menu"（太生硬），用 Could I see...；「买单」说 Could we get the bill 或 Check, please，不说 "pay money"。
